relations: Dante 正式搬进她的房子：衣物挂进衣帽间，连内衣都提前换新。
Ophelia 有翅膀做陶器；新胸罩订购自 pixie boutique。
Dante 自述追求时从不向前任敞开自己，故每段关系以厌倦收场；监狱第一夜她说过他 agreeable。
她刻意避免做爱避免动感情，认定他的工作与家族永远优先；他明言 I like you, Ophelia。

facts.fact: 淋浴时 Dante 从她羽毛间拈出一小块陶土，开始替她洗翅膀。
facts.anchor: He gently plucked something out of my feathers. I glanced over, and found a small chunk of clay between his fingers

facts.fact: 洗净翅膀后又替她洗头，再把半睡的她抱回床上。
facts.anchor: Dante washed my hair after my feathers, and carried me back to bed half-asleep when I was done

facts.fact: 她递腕供食，他只吻腕拒绝在她饿时咬，宣布带她去吃早餐。
facts.anchor: I can hear your stomach growling, Angel. There’s no world in which I bite you while you’re starving

facts.fact: 他宣布：那晚差点害她丧命，所以他搬进来是永久的，不容讨论。
facts.anchor: That nearly cost us both your whole life, Ophelia. I’m moving in. Permanently. It's not up for debate

facts.fact: 她发现内衣被整套换新，还订了同款新胸罩——pixie boutique 出货慢。
facts.anchor: I ordered you new bras in the same style as yours, too, but the pixie boutique they’re coming from doesn’t work quickly

facts.fact: Dante 剖白：从不向前任敞开自己，这就是每段感情厌倦收场的原因。
facts.anchor: I had a tendency to win women over without ever opening up to them. I've been thinking about it

facts.fact: 她摊牌：不想做爱因为会动感情，而他的工作与家族永远在前。
facts.anchor: You want the truth? I don't want to fuck you because it's going to make me feel things for you

facts.fact: 他说不是勉强容忍而是喜欢她；被问喜欢什么无言以对，松开她的手腕。
facts.anchor: barely tolerate you," he said in a low voice. "I like you, Ophelia
